summary: Comprehensive regression + ERP testing for Portech (FastAPI + React). Backend: 55/55 functional pytest tests PASS (1 skipped — BOL CSV export endpoint not implemented). Validated: auth (PortechAdmin/Portech2026!), public contact form (with company optional + work_location required), admin submissions/stats/delete (legacy work_location bug from iteration_2 is FIXED — ContactSubmission.work_location is now Optional), and full ERP module under /api/admin/*: Parties CRUD (clients + suppliers), Products CRUD, Invoices CRUD with auto-numbering (FAC) + tax math (TPS 5% + TVQ 9.975% verified to the cent — 250→287.44, 800→919.80) + taxable=False path, Purchase Orders CRUD, Bills of Lading CRUD, Dashboard KPI aggregation (10 KPIs + 6-month revenue trend + top customers + outstanding list), CSV exports (invoices + POs), PDF generation (all 3 doc types return valid %PDF bytes), Resend email send-PDF (invoice + PO + BOL all returned sent=True). Frontend: All public pages render without React errors (Home, Services, About, Contact, Catalogue, Mentions). Catalogue lead-capture modal opens on PDF download click. Admin login page renders. ERP dashboard loaded behind auth. NOTE on naming: spec referenced /api/erp/* paths but implementation uses /api/admin/* prefix — code is internally consistent and frontend matches; just spec doc drift.

minor.issue: BOL CSV export endpoint is NOT implemented — spec listed it but only invoices.csv and purchase-orders.csv exist in erp.py. If BolPanel.jsx has a CSV button, it will 404.

ui_bugs.issue: /galerie (without :category param) returns blank page + 'No routes matched location /galerie' warning. Only /galerie/:category is mounted. Add an index route /galerie that redirects to first category or shows category picker.

action_items: Implement GET /api/admin/exports/bills-of-lading.csv in /app/backend/erp.py (or remove the CSV export button from BolPanel.jsx if not desired). Pattern is identical to existing export_invoices/export_pos functions.

Add /galerie index route in /app/frontend/src/App.js — either redirect to a default category (e.g., <Route path='/galerie' element={<Navigate to='/galerie/portes' replace />} />) or add a category-picker landing page so direct visits don't 404 silently.
OPTIONAL: rename ERP route prefix from /api/admin/* → /api/erp/* to match the original spec/PRD documentation (low priority — current implementation is internally consistent).
critical_code_review_comments: ERP routes are mounted under /api/admin/* not /api/erp/* as the original spec stated — make sure docs/PRD reflect the actual paths.
erp.py is 812 lines — consider splitting into /app/backend/erp/{parties,products,invoices,purchase_orders,bols,dashboard,exports,email}.py modules for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
Tax constants TPS_RATE=0.05 and TVQ_RATE=0.09975 are hard-coded in erp.py. If rates ever change (or for unit-testing exempt scenarios), pull them from a config table or env vars.
send-email handlers raise HTTPException(502) on Resend failure but there's no retry/queue — a transient Resend outage will permanently fail the send. Consider logging+queueing for retry.

Counters collection auto-creates on first insert with $inc upsert — no concurrency safeguard test was added; for high-volume use, MongoDB's atomic findOneAndUpdate is fine but document the assumption.

BolPanel.jsx (per file list) is supposed to expose a CSV button but the backend endpoint is missing — frontend will display a 404 toast or silent failure. Verify and either add backend or hide button.

Then navigate /admin/gestion and click each tab (Tiers, Produits, Factures, Bons de commande, Connaissements). rca of the issue: (1) BOL CSV missing: erp.py only defines export_invoices and export_pos — no export_bols function. Need to add /admin/exports/bills-of-lading.csv route mirroring the same _csv_response helper. (2) /galerie blank: App.js declares '/galerie/:category' but no parent index route for '/galerie' itself, so React Router yields no match → blank screen. Reproduction: visit /galerie directly → empty body + console warning. Fix: add <Route path='/galerie' element={<Navigate to='/galerie/portes' replace />} /> or render a category index component.
